==Towers==
'''Crook''' may refer to these towers:
*[[Crook Boss]], an offensive [[Towers|tower]] that sends out goons to attack enemies.
**[[Crook Boss/Gallery]]
**[[Crook Boss/History]]
*[[Golden Crook Boss]], an upgraded version of the [[Crook Boss]]
**[[Golden Crook Boss/History]]

==Enemies==
'''Crook''' may refer to these event enemies:
*[[Null Crook Boss]], a high health enemy that spawns the [[Null Goon]] on death, that appeared in [[Outpost 16|Night I]], [[Banlands|Night II]] and [[Blind Faith|Night III]] of the [[Null & Void Event]].
**[[Null Crook Boss/Advanced Stats]]
==Units==
'''Crook''' may refer to these removed units:
*[[Crook]], a unit that was spawned by the Level 4+ [[Crook Boss]].
*[[Golden Crook]], a unit that was spawned by the Level 2-3 [[Crook Boss|{{Color|Golden}} Crook Boss]].
